speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry can review the policy concerning medical certificates issued by Ministry-approved TCM physicians and mandate its acceptance for medical leave claims across the board.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: This is already a wider recognition of MCs.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: I have residents who told me that they go to TCM for treatment, but then because the MC is not recognised, in the end, they just paid some money and got an MC from a clinic.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: They feel that they have to spend extra money and waste of time and waste of resources.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, I would like to ask how many of these TCM practitioners are registered with MRA, because the Minister mentioned that the MCs of only those registered with MRA are recognised.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: From what she has asked, I gather her concern is really with regard to individuals who are seeking to get the medical certificates because they feel unwell to work.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: There should not be a concern that the individuals have no access to doctors who can issue valid MCs.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Employers are certainly free to do more than what the Employment Act requires, to recognise other medical certificates.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: But the practice adopted within the Employment Act is consistent with MRA.
